youtubeTitle: GTA 6 Physical Copies Vulnerable to Flashlight Code Theft in PEGI Regions
socialHook: GameSpot reports GTA 6 physical copies in PEGI regions have download codes visible through the case with a flashlight.

sections.heading: Packaging Flaw Exposes Download Codes
paragraphs: GameSpot reports that physical copies of Grand Theft Auto 6 sold in PEGI regions print the game's download code directly on the inside of the cover art, rather than on a separate insert. When a flashlight is shone through the closed case, the code becomes visible in reverse, allowing potential thieves to photograph and redeem it before purchase.

sections.heading: Regional Differences and Rockstar Response
paragraphs: The vulnerability appears limited to PEGI regions; North American copies reportedly obscure the code intentionally. GameSpot has reached out to Rockstar Games for comment but had not received a response at publication. The code-in-box copies unlock on November 19 for PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S.

sections.heading: Community Discovery and Mitigation
paragraphs: The issue was first highlighted by users on the ResetEra forum and demonstrated in a YouTube video. Players who purchase physical copies are advised to redeem codes immediately or consider digital purchases to avoid potential theft. The thief cannot play the game until the November 19 launch date.
